purpose: Three-source canary on one React tree: BitHire static artifact, The Management DB full-appearance document, and a genuinely seeds-only DB document. Full-appearance proves broad runtime divergence; seeds-only proves bounded causal derivation. A probe passes only at a real consumer in computed style.

controlledVariables.note: All four must be held identical across the two sides. A divergence produced by changing viewport or ground is not evidence about the capability.

right.resolvedBy: DesignSystemProvider consumes TenantConfig.appearance through the DB/runtime path
right.law: This source proves the rich DB appearance path and broad multi-axis divergence. It MUST NOT be described as seeds-only; bounded seed causality belongs exclusively to sides.seedsOnly.

seedsOnly.allowlistProvenance: capability registry row palette.seeds (documentPath appearance.palette.{primary,secondary,accent,background}), expressed in the shape the provider consumes (appearance.general.palette). status-seeds is REJECTED today and dark-mode is tier internal, so neither is a seed.

probes.finding: RETRACTED an earlier claim that data-table.css's [data-part='header-cell'] rule was dead: the part IS stamped. The probe now pins autoMobileCards={false} so the real header consumer exists deterministically.

passCriteria: The mutated input produces a DIFFERENT artifact in the named channel.
The named channel reaches the named consumer file (wrap-immune boundary match, comments stripped).
The computed value at consumerSelector DIFFERS between the two sides.
A difference visible only in the artifact, or a consumer that does not render, is NOT a pass.
Text-matching a token name anywhere is NOT a pass.
knownLimits: TMM has no shipped bundle by design, so its side can never be read from styles/*.css; it must be compiled per probe.
chrome.anatomy, profiles.icon and responsive.posture declare NO css channel — they are proven through derivedRootAttributes, not computed style, and are out of scope for a colour/typography canary.
The four probes cover one capability each. They are a canary, not the propagation matrix; the matrix is the separate table-driven suite.

executableRoute.law: ONE React tree, source-selected. An unmountable source renders [data-testid=wc-source-failure] and NO tenant tree — never another vertical. Ordinary docs routes are NOT canary routes: they do not accept a DB-mounted tenant and can substitute a vertical silently.

contractMarkers.note: markers report the identity that ACTUALLY mounted, so comparing them against the query string makes substitution detectable from the DOM alone

probesB_seedsOnly.contract: four seeds derive a whole painted system
DRILL mutations move every claimed derived channel; restore byte-identical
